description: This file `arg-utils.mjs` provides utility functions for parsing command-line arguments and environment variables, including consuming specific flags and ranges, and creating option specifications for argument parsing.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads and parses a floating-point number from environment variables by name.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if a given command-line argument matches a specific flag and, if so, returns the next argument as its value.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag to consume a list of string values.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks if a command-line argument matches a specific flag to consume an integer value, respecting optional minimum.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks if an argument matches a float flag with optional minimum and inclusivity settings.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for string arguments with a specified key.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for string list arguments with a specified key.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for integer arguments with optional min value.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag consumer for float arguments with optional min and inclusivity options.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a boolean flag setting a key to true (or specified value) when matched.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Main function to parse command-line arguments (`argv`) according to a specification array (`specs`) with various options.
